results.question: For arbitrary states i, j, and k in a current Markov chain, what expression does Theorem 9-7 state reaches a limit as n approaches infinity?

**Conclusion:** Theorem 9-7 states that, as \(n \to \infty\), the expression

\[
\left(N_{kk}^{(n)} - N_{ik}^{(n)}\right)\frac{\alpha_j}{\alpha_k}
+ N_{ij}^{(n)} - N_{kj}^{(n)}
\]

reaches the limit

\[
{}^{k}N_{ij}.
\]

That is,

\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}
\left[
\left(N_{kk}^{(n)} - N_{ik}^{(n)}\right)\frac{\alpha_j}{\alpha_k}
+ N_{ij}^{(n)} - N_{kj}^{(n)}
\right]
=
{}^{k}N_{ij}.
